info.title: trunfoldlit
info.description:
Apply the unfold transform to a collection of terminal nodes
in the parse tree. This program is part of the Trash toolkit.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
The unfoldlit command applies the unfold transform to a collection of terminal
nodes
for string literal lexer rules in a grammar. An unfold operation substitutes
the right-hand side of a parser or lexer rule into a reference of the rule name
that
occurs at the specified node. In this app, all lexer rules that have a string
literal
on the right-hand side of the rule are identified as the symbols to unfold in
parser
rules.

options.name: --file
options.description: Read parse tree data from file instead of stdin.
